description: Drafts a bot on Angler's Bots page as a link that opens its window filled in: a grid bot (price range, grid count, investment), a market maker (spread, levels, quote size, inventory and loss caps) or a funding pair (long on one venue, short on another; once, held for funding, for volume, or for open interest rewards). It starts nothing: the user opens the link, checks the setup and starts it themselves. Bots run in the user's browser tab.

coin.description: grid / market_maker: the venue's market name, usually the ticker (BTC).

mode.description: grid: neutral (default), long or short. funding_pair: once, hold (default), volume or oi.

venue.description: grid / market_maker: the venue id (e.g. hyperliquid).

name: draft_bot
title: Draft a bot setup
